# kitsu 狐

> A Rust CLI for OpenAI-compatible hosted gateways and local model servers, with
> interactive chat, guarded developer tools, durable sessions, automation, and
> model-aware context management.

Kitsu is a Cargo workspace of five crates:

- `kitsu` — `init`, `doctor`, `ask`, verified `review`, `models`, `sessions`, and
  `chat`; slash commands; JSONL automation; `@file`; editable queues/steering;
  project context; bounded background-agent threads/profiles; reasoning control;
  and aggregate command-artifact lifecycle management.
- `kitsu-core` — the provider/tool agent loop, checked context preflight,
  offload/trim/summarize cascade, manual compaction, and compaction telemetry.
- `kitsu-providers` — provider traits and the shared OpenAI-compatible client,
  including streaming, physical-attempt telemetry, retry deadlines, and model
  discovery/cache behavior. Optional reasoning effort is transported only when
  configured.
- `kitsu-tools` — protected-path permissions, read/edit/write/search tools,
  verified diff/checkpoint journals, and opt-in literal-argv developer commands
  with exact approval plus mandatory fail-closed Linux OS containment.
- `kitsu-render` — sanitized terminal output, plain/reduced-motion rendering,
  streaming, diffs, tool activity, and usage/context telemetry.

Project context loading consumes this file's text only; markdown links are an
index for the model and are not followed automatically. Required context is
capped at one third of the active window. The `## Optional` section is included
only when the complete rendered file fits within one quarter of that window.
